messages:
maria (partner-eng): Heads-up: I'm putting together a compatibility matrix + reference README for marketplace Terraform modules (aim: consistent outputs, packaging layout, and a tiny CI smoke partners can run). Quick thoughts?
devon (arch): Love it. Key must-haves: standard outputs (endpoint_url, container_image, version_tag), metadata JSON for marketplace UI, and an examples/ directory. Add an outputs.tf snippet partners can copy.
anya (partner-eng): Also standardize inputs: region, arch (x86|arm), instance_size, and artifact_path. Make sensible defaults so partners can run locally.
lee (security): Include an automated scanning step (trivy/snyk) and require least-privilege IAM in examples. Add a note about secrets: recommend env var KMS or action secrets.
nik (partner-rel): We should provide a release checklist: docs, badge eligibility, sample billing SKU mapping. Partner-facing badge: `marketplace-validated` when CI passes.
maria (partner-eng): Draft plan: 1) repo template: modules/, examples/marketplace-quickstart/, monitoring/ 2) JSON schema for module metadata (name, version, arch, tags) 3) GH Action `marketplace-validate.yml` that runs: terraform init/validate/plan, apply to ephemeral account, curl /health and /v1/ping, push metrics to temp prometheus, then destroy. Target run <6m.
devon (arch): Example outputs.tf we can publish:
```hcl
output "endpoint_url" { description = "Public endpoint for quickstart" value = module.llm_service.endpoint }
output "container_image" { value = module.llm_service.image }
output "artifact_sha" { value = module.llm_service.artifact_sha }
```
anya (partner-eng): For the examples, include a tiny dev-compose that runs the runtime against a micro-model (quantized tiny) so partners without cloud creds can still run smoke tests.
lee (security): Add tflint + terraform fmt as a pre-step. Also require `--auto-approve` only in ephemeral CI, never in partner docs by default.
nik (partner-rel): I'll draft the partner comms and a short checklist partners paste into their PRs. Also want a label `marketplace-ready` on the repo when checks pass.
ci-bot: Draft workflow pushed to branch `marketplace/harness-template`. File: .github/workflows/marketplace-validate.yml (draft).
maria (partner-eng): Nice. Next steps: devon drafts outputs/metadata schema, anya builds the example dev-compose and README template, lee adds the security checklist and scan step, nik preps the comms/badge text. Aim to open PRs by next Tue.
